title: When can Optimally Trained Transformers Achieve Near-Lossless Token Prediction for non-Markovian Data?
abstract: arXiv:2610.41038v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: There exists little mathematical theory explaining why Transformer architectures are empirically successful even for non-Markovian data. To this end, this paper studies next-token prediction via stochastic optimal control theoretically trained Transformers for such sources, where we consider either stationary and ergodic non-Markovian sources or those which are hidden Markov models of some finite order (possibly non-stationary). In either case, we first obtain error bounds via finite models with finite window approximations. translated_title: 何时最优训练的Transformer能对非马尔可夫数据实现近乎无损的词元预测？
translated_abstract: 目前几乎没有数学理论能够解释为什么Transformer架构即使在非马尔可夫数据上也能取得经验上的成功。为此，本文通过随机最优控制从理论上研究了针对此类数据源的下一词元预测问题，我们考虑了平稳遍历的非马尔可夫数据源，或某种有限阶（可能非平稳）的隐马尔可夫模型。在这两种情况下，我们首先通过具有有限窗口近似的有限模型获得了误差界。对于平稳遍历数据源，所得误差由熵间隙界定；对于N阶马尔可夫数据源，误差以指数速率α^⌊M/N⌋衰减，其中M是窗口长度，α由滤波器稳定性（以及转移核和测量核的Dobrushin系数）决定。随后，我们构建了一个深度为M+1、每层具有一个注意力头的Transformer，实现了真正的……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 本文通过随机最优控制理论证明，最优训练的Transformer对非马尔可夫数据源的下一词元预测误差可由熵间隙界定（平稳遍历情形）或以指数速率衰减（N阶马尔可夫情形），并构建了深度为M+1、每层单头的Transformer实现近乎无损的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proves via stochastic optimal control that optimally trained Transformers can achieve near-lossless next-token prediction for non-Markovian sources, with errors bounded by an entropy gap for stationary ergodic sources or decaying exponentially at rate α^⌊M/N⌋ for Nth-order Markovian sources, and constructs a depth-(M+1) single-head-per-layer Transformer realizing this performance.
